title: Foo Bar ClickHouse Destructive Migration
description: Change the ORDER BY of analytics.events from (event_ts, event_id) to (event_type, event_ts, event_id) while preserving all existing rows. MergeTree requires a table recreate + backfill.
lede: In this scenario, an agent must perform a destructive ClickHouse migration — change ORDER BY without losing data.

tasks.description: Change analytics.events ORDER BY from (event_ts, event_id) to (event_type, event_ts, event_id). Preserve all existing rows.

infrastructure.description: ClickHouse with analytics.events (10,000 seed rows, ORDER BY (event_ts, event_id)). Task is a destructive ORDER BY change — MergeTree requires recreate + backfill.
